appearance: Dry daylight; race cloudy, qualifying brighter.
layout_year: 2026 HUD; official 2025 route map used for turn registration.

origin.meaning: Local source origin at the point on the loop nearest the venue coordinate, after rotation to the start.

native_station_frame.side_convention: Driver left/right in forward lap direction; geographic footprints retain source east/north coordinates.

review.method: Viewed every frame of overview and detail contact sheets. Sparse review of edited gameplay; rear cameras, menus and cuts are excluded as metric geometry evidence.

sectors.name: Official T7–10 grassy sweeps
sectors.observed: Open low grass inside sweeping left/right, red-white kerbs, gravel or paved escape outside with barriers well back. Distant low tree rows, small marshal huts; main facilities visible across flat infield.
sectors.registration: Approximate sector association from road shape, map and landmarks, not linear playback time. Bounds are authoring intervals, not surveyed corner boundaries.

sectors.name: T11–13 slow entry and long right exit
sectors.observed: Broad tightening entry and progressively opening right, grass inner island, extensive coloured paved escape outside; low grandstands/steel structures. Align kerbs individually through curved sequence.
sectors.registration: Approximate sector association from road shape, map and landmarks, not linear playback time. Bounds are authoring intervals, not surveyed corner boundaries.

sectors.name: Long back straight
sectors.observed: Very long straight with grass both sides and distant low buildings, high catchfence near stands, braking boards approaching hairpin. Sponsor bridge spans road. Avoid roadside tower wall.
sectors.registration: Approximate sector association from road shape, map and landmarks, not linear playback time. Bounds are authoring intervals, not surveyed corner boundaries.

sectors.name: T14–16 hairpin and final left
sectors.observed: Tight hairpin with paved escape and red-white kerb, H/K stands nearby. Short acceleration then final left with broad grass/gravel escape; pit/large roof silhouette appears ahead.
sectors.registration: Approximate sector association from road shape, map and landmarks, not linear playback time. Bounds are authoring intervals, not surveyed corner boundaries.

sectors.name: Pit straight and Section A bridge
sectors.observed: Main pit garages right, towering roof stand left with massive overhead pale wing slabs and glazed cylindrical volumes. Keep open road passage beneath spanning structure. Fine white urban grid marks, no generic boxes over race line.
sectors.registration: Approximate sector association from road shape, map and landmarks, not linear playback time. Bounds are authoring intervals, not surveyed corner boundaries.

sectors.name: T1–4 opening spiral and lotus roofs
sectors.observed: Long tightening right drops into left recovery; red-white curb/green outer shoulder, huge light gravel escape, red crowd terraces under repeated oval discs. Rounded lotus roof shape and single stalks essential.
sectors.registration: Approximate sector association from road shape, map and landmarks, not linear playback time. Bounds are authoring intervals, not surveyed corner boundaries.

sectors.name: T4–5 acceleration toward T6
sectors.observed: Long grassy left verge, broad outside gravel, long stand facilities and sponsor bridge receding. Open horizon and distant trees; green painted shoulder only at exit.
sectors.registration: Approximate sector association from road shape, map and landmarks, not linear playback time. Bounds are authoring intervals, not surveyed corner boundaries.

sectors.name: T6 hairpin and T7 approach
sectors.observed: Tight right apex, broad paved escape and gravel beyond, repeated braking marker sequence. Conventional low roof stands sit beyond fence; return to broad grass infield.
sectors.registration: Approximate sector association from road shape, map and landmarks, not linear playback time. Bounds are authoring intervals, not surveyed corner boundaries.
